EasyUse Anima 1.1.0 adds prompt-driven LoRA loading and public first-pass AiO Hook controls.

Changes:
1. Prompt Studio Advanced V2 recognizes A1111 and LoraManager-style LoRA tags after wildcard expansion, stores them in structured Prompt Data, and lets Anima AiO Generator apply them automatically.
2. Anima Prompt Studio Advanced LoRA and Anima Wildcard LoRA add LORA_STACK input and output sockets while preserving the behavior of their existing node counterparts.
3. Typing <: or <<: offers installed-LoRA autocomplete, completes a closed LoRA tag, selects the strength for quick editing, and uses a dedicated configurable highlight color.
4. LoRA parsing and highlighting remain separate from <|> and <|...|> prompt syntax.
5. Public AiO Hook v1 providers can replace the first-pass model and override the allowed first-pass steps, CFG, sampler, scheduler, and denoise settings.
6. Existing workflows, node identifiers, settings, profiles, socket order, and LoRA stack order remain compatible. Prompt-derived LoRAs are appended after existing stack entries.

Action required:
After updating, restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser. Route wildcard-produced LoRA tags through Prompt Studio Advanced V2 or a LoRA-enabled node before Anima AiO Generator.
